root.label: Lawsuit challenges ICE curricular practical training guidance

events.label: Lawsuit challenges ICE curricular practical training guidance

slots.name: lawsuit filing date
slots.sentence: A similar program that allowed international students to participate in internships and practicums also has faced scrutiny from the Trump administration. New guidance from U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement that the program, Curricular Practical Training, should only be authorized when the work experience is a degree requirement led to a lawsuit Monday.
